topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: Framing that introduces the lecture's focus on cancer evolution, contextualizes it within the course, and states the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive clonal selection.

topics.label: Tissue Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how tissue stemness and the differentiation state of the initiating cell influence tumor development across leukemia and solid tissue models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Support
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external microenvironmental cues and cellular interactions provide the permissive signals required for tumor initiation, outgrowth, and maintenance.

topics.label: Technologies for Profiling Tumors and Their Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental and computational sequencing technologies used to resolve tumor heterogeneity and map microenvironmental cellular interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, developmental, and microenvironmental factors converge to drive cancer progression through an evolutionary process.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: Framing that concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
